tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Local approximation by smooth functions] ↗ def:sobolev-space-wkp ↗ def:sobolev-convergence 1. ch5:5.3-thm-1\group Sobolev Space Approximation

Assume $u \in W^{k,p}(U)$ for some $1 \le p < \infty $, and set \[ u^\varepsilon = \eta _\varepsilon * u \text{ in } U_\varepsilon . \] Then

  1. $u^\varepsilon \in C^\infty (U_\varepsilon )$ for each $\varepsilon > 0$,

and

  1. $u^\varepsilon \to u$ in $W^{k,p}_{\text{loc}}(U)$, as $\varepsilon \to 0$.

Proof

\sketch Mollification is smooth on $U_\varepsilon $ and satisfies $D^\alpha u^\varepsilon =\eta _\varepsilon *D^\alpha u$. Approximate-identity convergence in $L^p$ for each $|\alpha |\le k$ gives local Sobolev convergence.

□
